description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Generalized CLASS of the P304 centrifuge M-06 miss: an admin/role/Auth contract exposes one half of a known capability PAIR (add/remove, pause/unpause, grant/revoke, schedule/cancel, freeze/unfreeze, enable/disable, rely/deny, lock/unlock, register/deregister) but NOT the inverse -> a granted capability cannot be reversed (e.g. a pauser can pause but not be un-paused / revoked promptly). Two-signal: S1 the contract is an admin/role/Auth contract; S2 a capability-pair half is present (external/public) while its inverse is absent. Suppress: non-admin contracts; pairs where both halves present. Anchor: centrifuge admins/PauseAdmin.sol exposes `pause` but no `unpause` (capability asymmetry in the M-06 admin layer). HONEST SCOPE: generalizes the admin capability-asymmetry class / recalls the M-06 subsystem; the exact cross-contract DelayedAdmin<->PauseAdmin role-graph gap is a role-graph nuance beyond a static lens.
_doc_role_gate: add/remove & register/deregister fire ONLY when the suffix is a role/permission noun, so append-only registries (addPool/addCurrency/addTranche) are not flagged — only reversible role grants (addPauser/addMinter/...).

fp_controls.two_signal_required: S1 admin/role/Auth contract AND S2 a capability-pair half present (external/public) with its inverse absent.
fp_controls.camelcase_boundary: a prefix only matches at a camelCase boundary (addPauser, not 'additional') — the char after the prefix must be uppercase or end-of-name.
fp_controls.both_halves_suppression: if both halves of the pair exist on the contract -> symmetric -> silent.
fp_controls.non_admin_suppression: a contract with no admin/role/Auth marker -> silent (avoids flagging core protocol verbs).
